current.text: He had a torn meniscus repaired and is expected to be out until around March. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.

He is not in Portland's projected starting five of Scoot Henderson, Damian Lillard, Toumani Camara, Deni Avdija and Donovan Clingan. The backcourt is crowded with Lillard, Ja Morant, Jrue Holiday and Henderson.
Experts disagree on drafting him. One will not draft him because he is out for most of the year. Another mock drafter took him at pick 77, ahead of his ADP of 99.
His jump in steals came from a 71% deflection-to-steal conversion, which the expert calls luck. Expect his steals to come down.
Portland plays 10 games in our fantasy playoff weeks, which is a weak count, and has three back-to-backs in those weeks.

durable.text: He is not a good fantasy player. He needs a lot of minutes and usage to produce.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 228, ESPN rank 331), and the projections give him only 27 to 30 games. He cost 4 USD in our league last season. He is out until around March after meniscus surgery, he has no starting job in a crowded backcourt, and Portland plays only 10 games in our playoff weeks, so leave him off our 144-player draft board. Check his recovery news in February and March, and treat him as a waiver option only if he comes back with real minutes before week 19.
